changes.repair: Before asserting an A-to-B presentation sequence, reread the actual adjacent source paragraphs, including across page breaks. Preserve the order of the author’s final scholarly task, policy advice and conditional prescription. The analyst may end with an open question, but must not relocate the source’s research question to the end to fit that analytical ending. Both prose and sequence cells must follow the source’s actual order.

Inventory consequential comparisons inside worked economic, institutional and financial applications as well as headline classifications and historical analogies. Where the text contrasts a policy justification with distributional or financial-power effects, reconstruct that comparison separately: actors, resources, valuation or control mechanism, warranted consequence and strongest alternative. Do not reduce such a comparison to naming a new business class, and do not turn every financial term into an analogy. Keep the audit compact enough that each distinct inference is visible.
